answer: Macaroons are bearer tokens that can be narrowed by adding caveats, so an agent delegates only a specific permission for a limited time and place, and the echo of the original token carries each caveat in a chained signature; across an ocean of delegated tokens, a relic of the root secret stays with the issuer, so a farm cannot widen a narrow token, because any added caveat only restricts further and verification fails if one is removed.
